speaker: Doctor
text:
The head CT scan reveals intraventricular hemorrhage, which explains the seizures and lethargy in this premature infant with a history of low Apgar scores. This is a common complication in very low birth weight neonates due to the fragility of the germinal matrix vessels.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage
